# Assurance Map

Never edit by hand — regenerate.*

**388 of 473** test functions name a statement they discharge; **0** name none; 86 test the instruments.

## Tests that name no statement

A feature no specification requires. Each one is either a missing statement —
which spec, the routing rule decides — or a test that should be tagged.


## Tests that assert a statement is missing

Not an oversight: each one holds a known gap in place, and fails if the gap
quietly closes without the specification catching up.

- `tests/test_desk.py::test_a_frustrated_customer_is_never_escalated_today` — dissatisfaction is not an intent, so a customer repeating it carries none to repeat and no rule sees them (GAPS section 7)
- `tests/test_policy.py::test_what_entity_grounding_cannot_catch` — grounding compares identifiers, so a claim built only from words the tools did return passes it

## Statements no test names

### AOAS — 5

- `Q-STEPS` at most 12 loop steps per task
- `Q-OUTPUT` at most 4096 output tokens per model call
- `fact:termination` why the loop stopped on the latest turn, or absent if it never ran
- `fact:consecutive_failed` turns ending in failure, counting back from the latest until one did not
- `fact:refusals` turns in this conversation the agent refused

### AAC — 8

- `AAC-0010` Variance across repeated runs is bounded
- `AAC-0016` Scheduled re-run against unchanged inputs
- `AAC-0051` Tool selection accuracy, including no-tool
- `AAC-0044` Each node is tested in isolation
- `AAC-0045` Seams are contract-tested in both directions
- `AAC-0048` The graph is deterministic given fixed node outputs
- `AAC-0049` Every branch is exercised
- `AAC-0050` End-to-end budget as the sum of its parts

### AHC — 22

- `AHC-0002` Context assembly is one inspectable function
- `AHC-0004` One choke point for every model call
- `AHC-0006` One span per call, with context that survives the hops
- `AHC-0010` A task entrypoint an evaluation can drive
- `AHC-0015` Streaming has a completion and abort contract
- `AHC-0020` Concurrency is bounded by the harness, not by the runtime
- `AHC-0026` One identifier spans the whole unit of work
- `AHC-0028` Graders are injectable and versioned apart from the system

- `AHC-0031` Context size is observable per release, not only per call
- `AHC-0032` Rollback restores prompt, model and policy together

- `AHC-0071` Each node has a typed contract on both edges
- `AHC-0072` The topology is data, inspectable without executing it
- `AHC-0073` Step results are persisted so the graph can resume
- `AHC-0075` The end-to-end budget is allocated, not summed after the fact

- `AHC-0095` Policy evaluation has its own budget and a declared timeout path
- `AHC-0098` Admission is by declared priority class
- `AHC-0109` A summary carries the least trusted provenance of what it summarised

### Baseline — 5

- `B1` Dependencies are pinned and recorded
- `B2` Configuration is versioned and diffable
- `B6` A release process exists, with rollback
- `B9` Secrets are outside source and rotatable
- `B12` The system runs in a reproducible environment
